newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.015PTS TO 103.386.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.015PTS TO 103.386.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.015 points in Wednesday's trading to 103.386 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.805 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.037 points to 100.997, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.346 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.582 points to 1,020.318.
